title: Session
description: <root>/<session>/session.json. A session is a working context: a cwd, the part of the catalogs it may use, and the active profile. It holds no model, tool or MCP definitions.

cwd.description: Working directory of every run in this session.

category.description: Optional folder name used to group sessions in listings. It does not change the session id.

scope.description: What this session may use. Each list narrows the catalog under .jad/. A profile can only narrow it further.

profiles.description: Narrows the profiles offered by the level above. Items: a file name, "category:<folder>" or "*". A missing key keeps everything the level above offers; [] keeps nothing. A plain name the level above does not offer is a load error; a category or * only intersects.

models.description: Narrows the models offered by the level above. Items: a file name, "category:<folder>" or "*". A missing key keeps everything the level above offers; [] keeps nothing. A plain name the level above does not offer is a load error; a category or * only intersects.

mcp.description: Narrows the MCP servers offered by the level above. Items: a file name, "category:<folder>" or "*". A missing key keeps everything the level above offers; [] keeps nothing. A plain name the level above does not offer is a load error; a category or * only intersects.

active_profile.description: Profile used when a request names none. Must be inside scope.profiles.

settings.description: Overrides of the setting keys listed in propertyNames. Objects merge key by key with the level above; arrays and scalars replace it. Each value follows the same key in setting.schema.json.
